title: 第648章 清源求升职第647章 天地父母逆子说
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
竹风穿过八卦洞天的听鱼小院，清源半透明的小小灵体斜倚在五米高随军丹炉的炉沿，两人的谈话在继续。
苏醒问出了最关心的一个问题：“说了这么多，那你自身是什么境界修为？手上可有仙庭正统炼气功法。”
清源闻言身形一僵，原本舒展的淡红火光骤然黯淡几分，脸上露出几分苦涩无奈，垂首回话：“老爷，小的根本谈不上什么境界，更没有资格修炼，自然也没有炼气功法。”
“仙庭制式器灵自有一套炼制法子，通常是用战时俘获的异族战俘、触犯天规的罪人，将其送入炼魂台剥离三魂七魄。”
“三魂中的胎光主生机、幽精主情欲根基，唯有爽灵独掌思绪记忆、辨识推演。”
“爽灵的这种特性恰好适配制式器物所需的智慧思虑，于是仙庭神匠便单单抽出生灵体内爽灵，熔入各种器物之内，铸就我这般器灵，便宜嘛。”清源童子自嘲地笑笑。
“我自诞生起，便只剩一缕孤立爽灵，三魂不全，七魄全无。”
“修士修炼需神魂完整，肉身神魂彼此滋养，我既无完整魂魄，又无肉身，已经断了修行的根基。”
“我只能依靠丹炉法阵维系灵体，而我的作用则是在丹炉之中总管灵能调和，发挥这死器的最大功效而已。”
苏醒听完心中了然，这器灵之说似乎和以前看过的小说不太一样，不过这样也合理，器灵确实不需要过于聪慧自主，能发挥器物的功效即可。
“那你可还记得自己生前之事？”
“那怎么可能，生前记忆早就被抹除了，入得丹炉之中，我相当于重生了一遍。”
这岂不是相当于一个真·人工智能，苏醒暗想，不过……
这样说起来，自己这次岂不是就得到了一个炼丹炉。
也不知用这炼丹炉给柳轻尘制作的丹药，还能不能获得职业规则和天赋的加成。
正在苏醒为这次布局收获不满意之时，那清源童子的小小身体从丹炉上跳下，跪倒在苏醒面前，“小的有一事相求，望老爷成全，赐予小的一个晋升之机。”
苏醒抬眼看向他：“你且说来听听。”
清源抬头望向整片八卦洞天，目光掠过流淌灵渠、成片开垦的药田……缓缓道出洞天的真实根脚：
“老爷这座洞天，绝非普通次元空间，乃是荡魔讨逆军其中一位万夫长的制式洞天。”
原来仙庭征伐星海，每一位万夫长都会配赐一座同款洞天，平日里用作蓄养人族，抽丁、屯兵、练兵之所在。

若是打下崭新灵气大螺旋臂，蓄养在此的人族就会占据新星域，休养生息。
洞天里的这些低阶军士将会成为星球的管理层，为仙庭对付星域土着的低阶抵抗势力，搜刮星球资源。
这类洞天皆是从异族洞天修士手中缴获，再按仙庭规制重炼改造，底蕴远非凡俗次元空间可比。
“小观老爷的此洞天，应当是经历大战，受创严重，法阵灵纹缺失，洞天之灵已经湮灭，只剩一个躯壳在勉强维持。”
清源童子叩首再拜，“小的斗胆，想要成为这洞天的洞天之灵，望老爷成全。”
“你先起来，成为这洞天之灵，对你有什么好处，对我又有什么好处。”苏醒不紧不慢地端起身旁矮桌上的一杯清茶，慢慢品着，他不着急，他现在是甲方。
content_en:
The bamboo wind passed through the small courtyard of Tingyu in Bagua Cave. Qingyuan's translucent little spirit body was leaning on the edge of the five-meter-high military elixir furnace. The conversation between the two continued.
Su Xing asked the question he was most concerned about: "Having said so much, what level of cultivation are you at? Do you have the orthodox qi-refining technique of Immortal Court in your hands?"
Qingyuan froze when he heard this, and the originally stretched reddish fire suddenly dimmed a bit, with a bit of bitterness and helplessness on his face. He lowered his head and replied: "Master, I can't even talk about the realm, let alone practice, and naturally I don't have any qi training methods."
"Xianting's standard weapon spirit has its own set of refining methods. Usually, foreign prisoners of war captured during war and sinners who have violated heavenly rules are sent to the soul refining platform to peel off the three souls and seven souls."
"Among the three souls, the embryonic light controls the vitality and the ghost essence controls the foundation of desire. Only Shuangling controls thoughts, memory, identification and deduction."
"This characteristic of Shuangling is exactly suitable for the intelligent thinking required for standard utensils, so the immortal craftsman simply extracted the Shuangling from the living beings and melted it into various utensils to create a utensil spirit like me. It's cheap." Qingyuan boy laughed to himself.
"Since I was born, I have only an isolated and refreshing spirit, three souls are incomplete, and all seven souls are gone."
"Cultivating a monk requires a complete soul, and the body and soul nourish each other. I have neither a complete soul nor a physical body, and the foundation of my practice has been cut off."
"I can only rely on the alchemy furnace array to maintain my spirit body, and my role is to manage the spiritual coordination in the alchemy furnace to maximize the effectiveness of this deadly weapon."
After listening to it, Su Xing understood clearly. The theory of weapon spirits seemed different from the novels he had read before, but it was also reasonable. The weapon spirits did not need to be too intelligent and independent, as long as they could play the role of the objects.
"Then do you still remember what happened during your lifetime?"
"How is that possible? My memories of my life have long been erased. Entering the alchemy furnace is like being reborn."
Isn't this equivalent to a true artificial intelligence, Su Xing thought to himself, but...
Speaking of which, didn't he get an alchemy furnace this time?
I don’t know if the elixir made for Liu Qingchen using this alchemy furnace can still obtain the bonus of professional rules and talents.
Just when Su Xing was dissatisfied with the results of this arrangement, the little body of the Qingyuan boy jumped down from the alchemy furnace and knelt down in front of Su Xing, "I have something to ask for. I hope that I will grant you a chance to be promoted."
Su Xing raised his eyes and looked at him: "Please tell me and listen."
Qingyuan raised his head and looked at the entire Bagua Cave, his eyes passing through the flowing spiritual canal and the cultivated medicinal fields... He slowly revealed the true foundation of the Cave:
"Master, this cave is by no means an ordinary dimensional space. It is a standard cave created by one of the Ten Thousand Captains who defeated the demons and defeated the rebels."
It turns out that when the Immortal Court conquers the Star Sea, every ten thousand captain will be given a cave of the same style, which is used to raise humans, draw troops, station troops, and train troops.
If a new spiritual energy spiral arm is laid, the human race stored here will occupy the new star field and recuperate.
These low-level sergeants in the cave will become the management of the planet, helping Xianting deal with the low-level resistance forces native to the Star Territory and plunder the planet's resources.
This kind of caves are all captured from the hands of foreign cave monks, and then refined and transformed according to the regulations of the Immortal Court. Their foundations are far beyond those of ordinary dimensional spaces.
"Master Xiaoguan's cave must have experienced a great war and suffered severe damage. The spiritual patterns of the magic circle are missing. The spirit of the cave has been annihilated, and only a body is left to barely maintain it."
The Qingyuan boy kowtowed and bowed again, "You are so bold and want to become the cave spirit of this cave. I hope you will do it."
"Get up first and become the spirit of this cave. What good will it do to you and what good will it do to me." Su Xing slowly picked up a cup of tea on the low table next to him and sipped it slowly. He was not in a hurry. He was Party A now.
